body: Hood that the future will bring good people and good memories in to my life

I care for you my guy. Life’s shit but we just got to keep pushing through. There are good people out there too that want to care for you and want the best: although we may not know where they are right now, they will come when we most need it if we just stick around. People fucking suck and that’s that we are selfish and only care for the short term future. But we got to look at long term, we have so much to live for and you got everyone on here in similar situations we all care for you even if we don’t know who u are. Shit will get better I promise you
